pageProps.title: Enabling GT911 Touchscreen on Raspberry Pi Zero 2W with Yocto
pageProps.review: A detailed guide on how to enable and configure the GT911 touchscreen via the Yocto Project as part of creating a custom device using a Raspberry Pi Zero 2W and a 7.5-inch E-Ink display.
pageProps.description: A step-by-step guide to configuring Yocto recipes and hardware setup for the GT911 touch controller
